description: MCP server that drives a real Google Chrome instance over CDP with logged-in session reuse, real file uploads, bot-wall detection, verified action statuses, search, screenshots, and multi-tab workflows.

commands: brew tap pitiflautico/neobrowser https://github.com/pitiflautico/neobrowser && brew install neobrowser

notes: The local MCP server does not require an API key. Real-profile cookie import is opt-in through environment variables, and sensitive actions can be gated with NEOBROWSER_REQUIRE_APPROVAL.
Issue #1962 and the public README confirm the real-Chrome CDP model, install paths, MCP config shape, 67-tool count, and MIT license. The tool count remains self-reported.
